result:
The proposed final answer of 2 cannot be right, and the solution itself is cut off mid-formula.

**Reasoning check.** With 2025 gnomes, the counts must be exactly {0, 1, …, 2024}, so some gnome has to see all 2024 others. That gnome's α-sector must contain every other point. This is possible only if some convex hull vertex has interior angle at most α.

If the gnomes are placed in convex position, the interior angles of the 2025-gon sum to 180·2023 degrees. Placing the points as a regular polygon makes every angle equal to 180·2023/2025. In that placement, α must be at least 180·2023/2025 ≈ 179.82, so inf S is close to 180. Also sup S ≤ 180, since α < 180. Hence inf S + sup S is close to 360, not 2.

My sketch also suggests S is roughly [180·2023/2025, 180), which would give 180 + 180·2023/2025 = 16192/45 ≈ 359.8. I did not prove the sufficiency direction, so I do not claim that value as the final answer. Even so, a sum of 2 is impossible, because it would require S to consist of tiny angles, and small α fails the hull-vertex condition above.

VERDICT: REJECT
